How much cashback can I earn with Mashreq noon Credit Card?
For more details and examples on cashback earning, please click here.
How do I check my cashback balances?
All your cashback earning will get accumulated on noon. You can review cashback earning details on the My Accounts page on your Noon Account as noon credits.
Cashback earned as part of the Mashreq Cashback Program will be reversed in the monthly cashback transferred to your Noon Account.
You can review cashback earning/reversal details on the My Accounts page on your Noon Account.
When and how can I redeem the cashback that I have earned?
Instantly redeem your cashback at noon, noon Food and noon minutes at the time of checkout.
Is there any minimum spend to start earning cashback?
No, there is no minimum spend requirement to earn cashback. You can earn cashback starting from first Dirham of spend.
Do I earn cashback on all the transactions on my Credit Card?
